records.subject: You're in -- let's get Blue Partners set up
records.body:
Hi Kai,

Welcome! A lot of new teams ask us the same thing in the first few days: how do I get my team in here. Short answer -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Reply any time.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.text: New signup alert -- *Blue Partners* just created a workspace on pro.

decisions.rationale: Account is 6 days old with no project, no invite, no key milestone, and zero tickets. Three Wrenfield emails (email:67b6174c, email:7c3fc198, email:b61c1cba) went unanswered, with no customer message at all, suggesting low engagement. Unaided activation in the remaining 8 days looks unlikely.

draft.subject: One next step for Blue Partners
draft.body:
Hi Kai,

I don't want to crowd your inbox, so this is my last check-in for now. Nothing's needed from you unless it's useful.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so the first project is usually the thing that makes everything else click. If you tell me what Blue Partners is tracking, I'll help you get that first project set up this week.

And when you're ready for the team, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Best,
Priya
